mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market and strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) does not produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it triggers market concerns about monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding economic output, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over a 60-day horizon as the market prices in stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for INDPRO and SPX 60d returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3.0% year-over-year signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market, which is associated with positive short-term S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) does not produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1800 thousand units signal a contraction in the housing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1800.
